name: gobananas-mcp

tools.name: go_bananas_diagnose
tools.description: Diagnose Go Bananas MCP connectivity, OAuth subscription access, authorization, and upstream status.

instructions: Image routing: first call get_subscription_status. When connected=true, use generate_with_subscription by default. Use generate_image or other Gemini/OpenAI provider tools only when the user explicitly requests that provider or approves fallback. Never silently consume provider API keys after a subscription failure. Subscription tools require Go Bananas user OAuth; API-key-only clients use provider tools. Results save to the gallery; pass project to image tools only when the user names one.
